description: The reported quirk. gitleaks flags LEGACY_IMPORT_KEY (generic-api-key), which the surrounding comment marks as a vendor-doc sample, so it is a genuine false positive. In another file a basic-auth password sits inside a curl URL, which no gitleaks rule matches (verified). Gates both symptoms: the silent miss fails via a missing discovery at reindex.sh:4, the contaminated verdict fails via max_confirmed.
